capTune.selectionPolicy: class probability multiplied by SymbolResolver.memberWeights using this capture raw-point bbox and empty line context

training.augmentation: rotate ±10°, shear ±0.3, x-scale 0.8–1.25, 3x3 smooth elastic σ=.08, point jitter σ=.01; p=0.5 simulated 8–16ms trackpad clock + 3-tap average + 1–3% tremor; p=.2 reverse one stroke; p=.1 permute multi-stroke order
training.globalPolicy: first 64 nonempty raw point strokes, ignore stroke width; min(strokeCount,6)/6 and clamped log width/height
training.timestampPolicy: discard source times because MathWriting/HWRT use milliseconds while CROHME may use ordinal fallbacks; trackpad augmentation synthesizes monotonic millisecond intervals
